subject: Discovery recap — coordinate demo deep dive + pilot readiness
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — coordinate demo deep dive + pilot readiness

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call today — I appreciated the context on Aurelia's triage workflow and the latency/cost pressure you flagged for the clinical summary step. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap (from our notes)
- Primary use case: automated triage summaries and next-action suggestions for ED clinicians (high throughput during peak hours).
- Key constraints: sub-300ms token latency for summaries; PII stays in your VPC during pilot; 4-week evaluation window.
- Success signals you mentioned: 90% clinician acceptance on proposed next-action, <15% hallucination rate on critical fields, and token cost under $0.003 per summary at target throughput.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive / demo + pilot kickoff where we walk the team through: topology options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), trial plan, prompt set and evals, and security controls so you can validate dataflow.

Three time windows that work on our side next week (PT):
- Tue Aug 4: 10:00–11:15
- Wed Aug 5: 14:00–15:15
- Thu Aug 6: 09:00–10:15

Can you confirm which slot works for you and who from your side will join (particularly the person who owns security/compliance and the primary clinical product owner)? Also, two quick asks to help us prepare:
1) Please share a short list of 8–12 representative notes/examples we can use for a live prompt/quality check (we can accept de-identified examples).
2) Any constraints on network/connectivity (e.g., do we need to run an on-prem adapter or will a VPC peering test be possible during the pilot?).

I've attached a lightweight pilot charter template and an example prompt pack to speed the kickoff prep. If the times above don't work, propose 2 alternatives and we'll adapt.

Attachments: pilot-charter-template.pdf (PDF, 48 KB), example-prompt-pack.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPilotDocs (pilot docs + template)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Priya Shah <priya@aureliahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — coordinate demo deep dive + pilot readiness

Thanks Sean — helpful recap and appreciate the template.

We can do Wed Aug 5 14:00–15:15 PT. Attendees confirmed so far: myself (Product), Dr. Miguel Alvarez (Clinical Lead), and Ravi Menon (Infrastructure/Cloud). Our security lead (Samir Chopra) asked to be looped into the kickoff but will probably attend the follow-up security deep dive; you can reach him at samir.chopra@aureliahealth.com.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Representative notes: I can share 10 de-identified encounter summaries by EOD Monday.
- Network: We prefer VPC peering for the pilot if possible; Ravi will detail our constraints in the kickoff.

On success signals — the acceptance metric is accurate, but we also want to measure clinician time saved (minutes per patient) and false-positive rate on suggested disposition; can we include those in the pilot charter?

I'll accept the Drive link you sent; I also uploaded a short rubric we currently use for manual QA to the same folder (security-perm already set to the link you provided).

Thanks — see you Wed the 5th.

Best,
Priya
Product Manager, Aurelia Health
priya@aureliahealth.com

Subject: Confirmed: Wed Aug 5 14:00 PT — agenda + pilot framing

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Priya. I've locked Wed Aug 5 14:00–15:15 PT on our calendar and sent a Google invite to the attendees you listed. Quick agenda and what's on us to prepare: 

Agenda (60–75m)
- 10m: Introductions + success criteria alignment
- 20m: Technical deep dive (SE to demo architecture options + latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 20m: Pilot plan and evaluation framework (pilot charter, prompt set, quality gates)
- 10–15m: Ops & security notes (networking, data access, KMS) + next steps

Pilot framing (what we'll propose during kickoff)
- Length: 4 weeks active evaluation + 1 week wrap/reporting
- Primary metrics: clinician acceptance, avg time saved per patient, hallucination rate on critical fields, cost per summary
- Deliverables: sample prompt pack + baseline evals, pilot configuration (hosted/dedicated/private options), runbook for seizure windows and failover

Requests to your team before the kickoff:
- Upload the 10 de-identified notes (thanks in advance)
- Provide Samir's security contact on calendar or via email so we can schedule the follow-up security sync

Internal ask (Monica/Ben): Monica, can you lead the technical portion and plan to demo a 2–3 minute live prompt flow? Ben, please prepare a 2-page cost estimate for the 4-week pilot (hosted vs dedicated) so we can share during the call. I'll draft the pilot charter slide during the meeting and capture acceptance criteria.

I've added the pilot charter and prompt pack to the Drive folder and put a draft HubSpot note under deal/1327.

Docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPilotDocs
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/1327

Thanks — see you on Wednesday.

Best,
Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurelia kickoff — prework + roles (don't forward)

Team — quick internal note before the kickoff tomorrow: 

- Monica: own the technical deep dive; focus demo on the latency profile for 256-token summaries and show how prefix caching reduces cost spikes. Plan a short live run using the sample prompt pack I uploaded.
- Ben: prepare the cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and have a slide showing expected TL;DR cost per summary at 500 RPS and at 2k RPS. Also include a note on trial discounts / credits we can offer to help them hit the 4-week window comfortably.
- I'll draft the pilot charter on the call and capture acceptance criteria live; afterwards, Monica please own the follow-up security doc to Samir and loop engineering if a VPC adapter is required.

Attachments (internal for prep): pilot-charter-template.pdf, example-prompt-pack.csv
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/1327

Thanks — let's be crisp and come prepared with demo artifacts.

Sean
